decisions.reason: It fits the firm’s announced push in modular environmental technology and already has a public quantified customer-success reference, so management is very likely to stay committed.
As a close extension of the core mobile processing range with its own webpage, it reflects visible investment and can easily be defended as still ramping up in the market.
This modular product line is central to the firm’s stated direction and likely absorbed substantial development resources across several models, which strongly favors continued commitment.

Although the public commitment appears lighter than for the others, it remains close to the established offer and in a growing firm management would usually give it more time rather than withdraw it quickly.
